                            Delhi News

                            What changed at Jantar Mantar after July 20? I visited the site 6 times

                            My six visits to Jantar Mantar changed my perspective on what a protest can become. I marked July 1, July 10, July 15, July 19, July 21 and July 23 to visit the site and witness its evolution firsthand. In recent memory, few demonstrations have reached this scale. What began as an ordinary protest on Day 1 looked completely different by July 23, after the chaos of July 20. Young people from all walks of life arrived in solidarity, looking after one another and taking ownership of the movement.

                            History Of It

                            US spy satellites made India abort nuclear test. Then, Buddha smiled again

                            Two decades after the Pokhran-I nuclear test in 1974, India was ready to test again in 1995. But American spy satellites spotted unusual activity at Pokhran before it could. This is why PM PV Narasimha Rao withheld the final clearance, and the move helped pave the way for the successful Pokhran-II tests three years later.

                            Live: Education Ministry to announce major NTA reforms at 8 pm

                            Cockroach Janta Party Nationwide Protest Live Updates: After a day of high political drama, the CJP-led agitation over the alleged NEET paper leak remains on edge as the Centre is set to announce major NTA reforms at 8 pm while another round of talks with protesters is scheduled for Saturday.
